title: an install check measures that a spawn interpreter imports what its caller imports
intention: A registered install-inspector check reds a box whose spawn interpreter (background_python()) does not share its caller's site-packages, naming the interpreter and the prefix each reports.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: background_python() returned the base interpreter, not the venv, and a child died at import psycopg2 (bus.log); fixed in bfbfe42a7
traces_to: Law 3: an install is not known until measured. Law 4: install facts are enforced by an inspector, not remembered.
how: Once the install inspector exists (bdd0ed77930f), add check_spawn_interpreter(dry_run) in the Recovery installer shaped {id,status,detail}: run background_python() with -c 'import sys; print(sys.prefix)' and compare with sys.prefix; register it in CHECKS. The red-first proof feeds a runner stub that reports a different prefix.

clauses.claim: a stub spawn interpreter reporting a prefix different from the caller's makes the check return offered, naming both prefixes
a spawn interpreter reporting the caller's own prefix returns already_applied

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: background_python() returned the base interpreter, not the venv, and a child died at import psycopg2 (bus.log); fixed in bfbfe42a7
measured.how: background_python() run with -c 'import sys; print(sys.prefix)' compared with the venv's sys.prefix; recorded in ticket bdd0ed77930f's measured
